mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, p.version_id, p.plan_no, p.planned_at, p.owner_user_id, p.notes, p.risks, p.status, p.revision, p.scope_token, p.environment, p.coverage, p.created_at, p.updated_at, NULL AS versionIds, NULL AS versions FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{planId}

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.item_type AS itemType, t.board_column AS boardColumn, t.priority, t.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, COALESCE(u.display_name, t.owner) AS ownerName, t.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, t.due_date AS dueDate, t.completed_at AS completedAt FROM version_release_plan_task pt INNER JOIN task t ON t.id = pt.task_id AND t.workspace_id = pt.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE pt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pt.plan_id = #{planId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.name, t.item_no, t.id
SELECT * FROM version_release_plan_task_check WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO version_release_plan_task_check (workspace_id, plan_id, task_id, user_id, state, note, scope_token, planned_at_snapshot, checked_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{planId}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{state}, #{note}, #{scopeToken}, #{plannedAtSnapshot}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = VALUES(state), note = VALUES(note), scope_token = VALUES(scope_token), planned_at_snapshot = VALUES(planned_at_snapshot), checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO version_release_plan_push (id, workspace_id, plan_id, scope, sender_id, only_unconfirmed, channels, note, recipient_count, group_sent, group_error) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{planId}, #{scope}, #{senderId}, COALESCE(#{onlyUnconfirmed}, 0), #{channels}, #{note}, COALESCE(#{recipientCount}, 0), #{groupSent}, #{groupError})
INSERT IGNORE INTO version_release_plan_push_recipient (push_id, workspace_id, user_id) VALUES (#{pushId}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE version_release_plan_push_recipient SET in_app_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{pushId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE version_release_plan_push_recipient SET email_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{pushId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE version_release_plan_push_recipient SET wecom_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{pushId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.push_id AS pushId, r.in_app_at AS inAppAt, r.email_at AS emailAt, r.wecom_at AS wecomAt, r.acked_at AS ackedAt, p.created_at AS pushAt, p.scope AS scope, p.note AS note FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r INNER JOIN version_release_plan_push p ON p.id = r.push_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.plan_id = #{planId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, p.plan_id, p.scope, p.sender_id, p.only_unconfirmed, CAST(p.channels AS CHAR) AS channels, p.note, p.recipient_count, p.group_sent AS groupSent, p.group_error AS groupError, p.created_at, u.display_name AS senderName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r WHERE r.push_id = p.id AND r.in_app_at IS NOT NULL) AS inAppCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r WHERE r.push_id = p.id AND r.email_at IS NOT NULL) AS emailCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r WHERE r.push_id = p.id AND r.wecom_at IS NOT NULL) AS wecomCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r WHERE r.push_id = p.id AND r.acked_at IS NOT NULL) AS ackedCount FROM version_release_plan_push p LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.sender_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.plan_id = #{planId} AND p.id = #{pushId}

SELECT r.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.display_name, r.user_id) AS name, r.in_app_at AS inAppAt, r.email_at AS emailAt, r.wecom_at AS wecomAt, r.acked_at AS ackedAt FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient r LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.push_id = #{pushId} ORDER BY (r.acked_at IS NULL) DESC, u.display_name, r.user_id
SELECT user_id FROM version_release_plan_push_recipient WHERE push_id = #{pushId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_plan_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO version_release_plan_watch (workspace_id, plan_id, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{planId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM version_release_plan_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM version_release_plan_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM version_release_plan_watch w INNER JOIN version_release_plan p ON p.id = w.plan_id AND p.workspace_id = w.workspace_id WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.user_id = #{userId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version x INNER JOIN project_version v ON v.workspace_id = x.workspace_id AND v.id = x.version_id WHERE x.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND x.plan_id = w.plan_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = x.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = v.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none') )

SELECT p.id AS planId, p.workspace_id AS workspaceId, p.plan_no AS planNo, p.planned_at AS plannedAt, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, p.environment, p.coverage, p.scope_token AS scopeToken, p.status FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.status = 'ready' AND p.planned_at >= #{dateFrom} AND p.planned_at < #{dateTo}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO version_release_plan_milestone (workspace_id, plan_id, user_id, milestone) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{planId}, #{userId}, #{milestone})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM version_release_plan_milestone WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
